player_prompt.intro:
O u Mothami {player_id} o tshamekang game ya Pig Dice.

Melao:
- Ka turn ya hao, u ka '[roll]' kapa '[hold]'
- Fahlana 2-6: Ongeza ho ya ka turn ya hao
- Fahlana 1: Hauhaufi turn total ya hao, o fele turn
- Emisa: Ongeza turn total ho ya score ya hao, o fele turn
- Ya pele ho {winning_score} dipontsho e fenya

Ha o bona turn ya hao, u tla bona dipontsho tse seng tsa nano le turn total.
Retsa '[roll]' ho fahlana tshidiso kapa '[hold]' ho ngwala dipontsho tsa hao.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Foroma ya action e ile e senyehi. Sebelisa '[roll]' kapa '[hold]'.
